description.value: A McDonald's fast food restaurant located inside or adjacent to a Walmart on Hillside Drive in Kamloops, offering burgers, chicken, wraps, McCafé beverages, and snacks. Situated in a large retail parking area, it serves as a convenient urban food stop for cyclists passing through the Kamloops corridor. Ordering is available via the McDonald's app with contactless payment, as well as curbside pickup and delivery.
